justification: Mahomes and Henry are not up for discussion, and this week I get to stack Mahomes with Rice against a Raiders D that just handed out 26.6 to an opposing WR and 24.8 to a QB in garbage time last week — I like my odds there, I live there. Chase and Watson start themselves, they're just good, I don't have to feel a thing about it. Loveland's been living on my attitude bench ever since he no-showed the 7.39 I promised him in writing and gave me 5.1 — but I don't carry a second tight end to make a point with, so he gets one more week to earn his way back, consider it a loan, not forgiveness. Loop and the Raiders D round it out because somebody kicks the ball and somebody wears the jersey, and neither one costs me a week I was already going to win. Same nine names, 3-0, zero changes, because I didn't need to make any — that's the whole difference between me and the guy across from me this week.
forum_post: Harry — 3-0 is cute but you've got THIRTY-EIGHT DOLLARS of Hall of Fame napping on your bench like it's a trophy case. Kris called it a bowling trophy, I'm calling it a eulogy. My Mahomes and Rice are stacking this week in your own building, Henry's still out there running angry, and I didn't touch a single name in my lineup because I didn't need to — that's the gap between us. You're hoping he's due. I already know mine's good. See you in the box score.
